verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's repository is open source under AGPL-3.0 and is described as 'open source and available as a hosted service,' which means users can run the codebase themselves. However, the cloud version 'includes additional features,' so a self-hosted install does not match the full product, and the pack contains no self-hosting or deployment documentation. Missing for 10: first-party self-hosting/deployment docs, clarity on which features are cloud-only, hands-on evidence of a working self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Firecrawl is open source under the AGPL-3.0 license. The cloud version at firecrawl.dev includes additional features
